title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87387234: a marked density chain to the 1/2 floor
description: Proves all-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re(s) > 43693617/50000000 = 0.87387234, with the principal pole excluded. (1) Marked HIGH leaf. In Sil's density step (sil-density-split-20261026, PR 83) every HIGH row was counted by the unmarked zero-density exponent rho(nu). Here the HIGH rows are counted with the repeated-mark count of arvi-repeated-marks-on-sil-face-20261025 (PR 76: amplitude classes, eight copies of each marked slot, the parent face as plain moment), so the HIGH price becomes nu(P + s) - (1 - rho(nu))M - gainC(nu, B0, L0, c0, s, M). The step theorem `density_step_marked` replaces Sil's two HIGH gates by one marked gate, highJ + gainC >= r for every nu in [q(v), 3/4]. It is certified by reflection (Cert/Reflect.lean): for each facet branch the cleared gate polynomial in (v, nu, class) is computed in Lean from the step's rational data and proved equal to the gate once for all parameters; its positivity on the box is PR 76's kernel-evaluated tree test checkZ (Bernstein form in nu and class, dyadic intervals in v), so each step costs six `decide +kernel` checks. (2) Density floor 1/2. Collet's natural-dictionary zero-density count is used on bins a >= 3/4 (Collet's own a >= 3/4 restatements; Sil's step used a >= 33/40), so the density cut may go down to 1/2, as in density-refined (PR 90). Without marks this is worth little; with the marked leaf the chain continues to Lambda = 1.9265. (3) Chain. 129 exact marked steps (Delta Lambda = 1/200) from PR 86's boot face G(99999/100000, 5143/2000, 1397/10000) to the count face G(96232839/100000000, 3853/2000, 1/10); step 64, G(49283557/50000000, 4503/2000, 1/10), is the physical face. (4) Return. Sil's return regenerated for these faces, with the count branches capC and weakC7 of PR 76's final return restored (the three branches of PR 86 cannot certify faces this far down) and the transport box widened to ell < 175/1000; theta = 43693617/50000000 at h = 8044451/10000000 (47 rows, 31 windows). Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Sil, Jacob Sussman and our earlier repeated-mark work; inherited notices and licenses are retained. The research, certificate generation and Lean development were AI-assisted.
